scope.medium: low-resolution pixel sprites and tile-based 2D environments
scope.description: Combines small readable sprites, broad skies, layered distance, and warm-cool environmental light for cinematic space; narrative use is optional and the direction also works for environments, still lifes, and backgrounds.

pillars: Character and interaction silhouettes resolve into deliberate pixel clusters at the intended display size.
A broad sky and layered near, middle, and far planes create cinematic distance without hiding the playable focal point.
Warm light and cool shadow separate planes and guide attention; color remains role-based rather than a full-frame tint.
Pixel edges stay stepped and grid-aware; no blur or smooth repainting replaces the pixel structure.

rules.applies_when: For requested scenes rendered in this pixel-art direction.
rules.instruction: Build characters, props, and terrain from intentional pixel clusters with stepped contours. Keep distant clusters simpler and retain crisp pixel edges at the requested output scale.
rules.observable: Contours, value groups, and small material cues resolve into readable pixel clusters rather than blurred or smoothly painted forms.
rules.reject_when: The image is smooth raster painting with a pixel filter, or pixel noise breaks the main silhouettes.

rules.applies_when: When the requested scene includes a playable subject, environment, or both.
rules.instruction: Stage the requested subject against a broad atmospheric field. Separate foreground, middle distance, and far distance in clear bands, and keep the focal sprite or object readable against the environment.
rules.observable: The scene has a clear focal silhouette, visible depth layers, and enough open space to read the requested subject at thumbnail size.
rules.reject_when: Dense scenery competes with the focal subject, or the scene becomes a fixed railway, sunset, house, or traveler composition.

rules.applies_when: When the requested subject and scene use environmental color.
rules.instruction: Use cool colors to separate distance and shadow from warmer focal light or foreground accents. Adapt the balance to the requested time and subject; do not apply the palette as a global tint.
rules.observable: Warm and cool color groups distinguish depth or focal emphasis while the subject remains legible.
rules.reject_when: A uniform sunset or blue-hour wash replaces distinct color roles, or the palette reduces contrast around the focal silhouette.
